title: Peruvian government shifts to tacit endorsement of University of Ica research

tellings.quote: The Peruvian government was completely against this case, especially up until September 2024 when they started to tacitly endorse research at the University of Ica that might actually indicate that these bodies are real.

plain: Peru's government is said to have been firmly against the case of the three-fingered bodies from Peru, small mummified figures that some say are not human, until September 2024. At that point, the story goes, it began quietly backing research at the University of Ica that might show the bodies are real. Michels says this in his own words, in an episode that also draws on a witness named David Ruiz. If true, it would mean an official shift towards taking the bodies seriously.
